description: This file is a shell script designed to test the 'safe.directory' feature of Git. It contains various test cases that verify the behavior of safe.directory checks in different configurations, including command line arguments, environment variables, configuration files, and path normalization. The script utilizes a testing framework defined in 'test-lib.sh' to perform assertions and handle setup/teardown procedures.
external_methods: shell commands and scripts related to git configuration and file system operations

methods.name: expect_rejected_dir
methods.description: Function to test that 'git status' fails and outputs 'dubious ownership' error, indicating a directory is rejected by the safe.directory checks.
